snippet.title: THRUST FALL - Announcement Trailer | VR Space Racing Game
snippet.description:
Jetpack through Space! The ultimate experience of freedom and speed. Thrust your way through asteroid fields, speedways and deserted colonies at speeds never before achieved—until now. 

Thrust Fall isn't for the faint of heart. It's a physics playground that gives complete control to the player.

    - Realistic Newtonian flight physics with momentum conservation
    - Thrust in any direction at any time
    - Feather the throttle and boost for precise and granular control
    - Manage your fuel consumption and grab Fuel cans to refill

Your VR controllers become your ship's thrusters. Feel the tension as you narrowly avoid collisions, and the satisfaction when you perfectly execute a maneuver.

Built for Meta Quest VR, Thrust Fall delivers unparalleled speed, freedom, and cosmic exploration. How fast can YOU go? Wishlist now on the Meta Quest Store!

Thrust Fall Website: https://danielpaulgriffin.github.io/thrustfall

Check out my other games on Steam:
Arcade Moonlander: https://store.steampowered.com/app/727020/Arcade_Moonlander/
Astro-Not: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1687560/ASTRONOT/

Want to play a thrust game right now? Check out AstraLander on my homepage: https://danielpaulgriffin.github.io

Music: 'Space' by Music_Unlimited https://pixabay.com/users/music_unlimited-27600023/
